description: This file initializes and manages database connections for different database types (sqlite, mysql, mariadb, postgres) using TypeORM DataSource. It includes environment-based configuration, SSL setup, and a singleton pattern for the DataSource instance.

classes.name: DataSource
classes.description: TypeORM DataSource class used for database connection management.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the DataSource based on environment variables and database type.

methods.name: getDataSource
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the DataSource, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getDatabaseSSLFromEnv
methods.description: Configures SSL options for database connection based on environment variables.
